question_text: A male supervisor repeatedly tells a female employee that she will only get a promotion if she goes on a date with him. The employee feels pressured and uncomfortable. Under RA 7877 (Anti-Sexual Harassment Act), which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: This is not sexual harassment because the supervisor did not make any physical advances.
This is sexual harassment because the supervisor demanded a date as a condition for employment benefit.
The employee must first report the incident to the supervisor's immediate superior before it can be considered harassment.
Sexual harassment only occurs in a workplace where there is a superior-subordinate relationship.
